description: A logistics related physical location or place.

associatedGeographicalFeature.description: A geographical feature associated with this logistics location.

countryName.description: A country name, expressed as text, of this logistics location.

countrySubDivisionId.description: The identifier of the country sub-division for this logistics related location.

description.description: A textual description of this logistics related location.

facilityLocation.description: A facility location referenced for this logistics location.

healthAffectedAreaIndicator.description: The indication of whether or not this logistics location is in a health affected area.

identifier.description: A unique identifier for this logistics related location, such as a United Nations Location Code (UNLOCODE) or GS1 Global Location Number (GLN).

inspectionEvent.description: A supply chain inspection event at this logistics location.

locationFunctionTypeCode.description: A code specifying the type of this logistics related location.

logisticsLocationCountryId.description: The unique identifier of a country for this logistics location.

name.description: A name, expressed as text, of this logistics related location.

physicalGeographicalCoordinate.description: Geographical coordinate information for this logistics related location.

postalAddress.description: The postal trade address information for this logistics related location.

previousAssociatedGeographicalFeature.description: A geographical feature previously associated with this logistics location.

servicingSpecifiedParty.description: A servicing party specified for this logistics related location.

specifiedInspectionEvent.description: An inspection event specified for this logistics location.

stayPeriod.description: A period of stay at this logistics location.

subordinateRelatedLocation.description: A logistics location subordinate to this logistics location.

subordinateSubordinateLocation.description: A location subordinate to this logistics related location.

uTCOffsetNumeric.description: The time offset value from the Universal Time Coordinate (UTC) for this logistics related location.
